evidence.exactTip: Analyzer is certain about this finding.
evidence.overapproxTip: May contain false positives — engine over-approximated.
evidence.unknownTip: Confidence unknown — analyzer could not resolve precisely.

calib.passRateGloss: What fraction of recent PRs the gate let through, with a 95% confidence interval — narrow CI ⇒ stable, wide ⇒ undersampled.
calib.meanF1Gloss: Per-rule precision/recall harmonic mean against synthetic ground truth (PR=problematic iff a blocking rule fires). Low F1 ⇒ rule fires when it shouldn't, or misses when it should.
calib.evidenceMixGloss: Honesty bar: how many of the engine's matches are exact vs over-approximations vs unknown. A green checkmark on an unknown match is a lie — surface it.

actionPlan.empty: No rules fired on this PR. Regenerate to sample a different change set.
